tasks.name: Prepare budget quotations
tasks.description: Quote budget price, delivery and outline scope for major equipment against preliminary data.

needs.info: Preliminary datasheets: duty, size, design P/T, materials
Budget enquiry with scope and due date

tasks.name: Prepare firm technical and commercial quotations
tasks.description: Design to the RFQ and submit the technical offer, deviations and priced commercial offer.

needs.info: RFQ package: MR, specifications, datasheets, commercial terms, VDRL
Process datasheets: duties, operating and design conditions, fluid properties
Mechanical datasheets and project specifications
Instrument and control requirements for packages
Electrical supply data, motor and hazardous area requirements

tasks.name: Answer bid clarifications
tasks.description: Respond to technical and commercial clarification questions during evaluation.

needs.info: Technical clarification questions from the TBE
Commercial clarification questions and bid bulletins

tasks.name: Issue the vendor document schedule
tasks.description: After PO, list each vendor document with project number, type and planned submission date.

needs.info: Purchase order with VDRL and document numbering instructions
Assigned project document numbers

tasks.name: Prepare GA and outline drawings for review
tasks.description: Produce GA drawings with nozzles, orientations, weights, loads and anchor bolts for review.

needs.info: Approved datasheets and nozzle schedule
Nozzle orientation and allowable load requirements
Review comments returned on previous revisions

tasks.name: Prepare vendor design calculations
tasks.description: Mechanical design calculations (thickness, nozzles, wind/seismic, rotordynamics) to code.

needs.info: Design conditions, code, materials, corrosion allowance, nozzle loads
Wind and seismic design data for the site

tasks.name: Prepare package P&IDs, I/O and control narrative
tasks.description: Produce package P&IDs, instrument list, I/O list and control narrative for interface with the plant DCS/SIS.

needs.info: Process P&IDs and control philosophy at the package battery limits
Instrument specifications, tagging rules, DCS/SIS interface and communication protocol
SIF requirements and SIL targets affecting the package

tasks.name: Prepare package electrical data
tasks.description: Provide motor datasheets, electrical loads, local control panel data and heat tracing needs.

needs.info: Supply voltage, frequency, fault level, hazardous area classification, motor specification

tasks.name: Incorporate comments and issue certified final data
tasks.description: Resolve review comments and issue certified drawings and data as final.

needs.info: Consolidated review comments and review codes returned by transmittal
Approved review status on GA and calculations

tasks.name: Prepare the ITP and manufacturing schedule
tasks.description: Issue the inspection and test plan and manufacturing schedule with milestones.

needs.info: PO inspection requirements and delivery dates
Required tests and inspection level

tasks.name: Procure raw materials and issue MTRs
tasks.description: Buy plates, forgings, pipe and components and collect material test reports with heat numbers.

needs.info: Approved design and bill of materials (VEND-T060, VEND-T090)

tasks.name: Fabricate and test the equipment
tasks.description: Fabricate, weld, NDE, pressure test and run performance or FAT tests, issuing inspection notices and certificates.

needs.info: Certified drawings and MTRs (VEND-T090, VEND-T110)
Agreed ITP with hold/witness points and inspector contact

tasks.name: Fabricate pipe spools
tasks.description: Fabricate spools from IFC isometrics, weld and test, and report spool status with heat traceability.

needs.info: IFC isometrics with spool breaks, weld numbers, piping class and NDE requirements
Free-issue or purchased bulk material receipts at the fabrication shop
Spool delivery priority by CWP

tasks.name: Detail and fabricate structural steel
tasks.description: Produce shop drawings from the Tekla model, fabricate, coat and mark steel members.

needs.info: IFC structural steel drawings and Tekla model with connection design
Erection sequence and delivery priority

tasks.name: Report manufacturing progress
tasks.description: Issue periodic progress reports against milestones with forecast dates.

needs.info: Expediting requests and report format
Baseline manufacturing schedule (VEND-T100)

tasks.name: Pack, preserve and ship
tasks.description: Prepare packing lists, preservation and shipping documents for released items.

needs.info: Inspection release note and shipping instructions
Logistics plan constraints: envelope, marking, routing

tasks.name: Prepare nameplate and as-built data
tasks.description: Issue nameplate data and as-built dimensions, weights and serial numbers.

needs.info: Final test results and as-built measurements (VEND-T120)

tasks.name: Compile the MDR / data book
tasks.description: Assemble certified drawings, calculations, MTRs, weld and NDE records, test certificates into the data book.

needs.info: Certified drawings, MTRs, test certificates and nameplate data (VEND-T090 to T170)
Data book index and format requirements

tasks.name: Prepare IOM manuals and spare parts lists
tasks.description: Issue installation, operation and maintenance manuals and spare parts interchangeability records.

needs.info: Spare parts list format and maintenance system requirements

tasks.name: Configure and test the DCS/SIS
tasks.description: Configure control and safety logic, graphics and alarms and run FAT with the project team.

needs.info: I/O list with tags, ranges, alarms and signal types
Control narratives, cause and effect matrix and SRS
Alarm and trip setpoints and operating philosophy
Package I/O lists and communication maps (VEND-T070)

tasks.name: Provide site services
tasks.description: Supervise installation, assist pre-commissioning and commissioning and report findings.

needs.info: Site service call-off with dates
Commissioning procedures and system readiness

items.name: Budget quotation
items.content: Budget price, delivery, outline scope, weight and main dimensions.

items.name: Technical quotation
items.content: Compliance statement, completed datasheets, outline drawings, weights, utilities, performance guarantees.

items.name: Commercial quotation
items.content: Price breakdown, options, spares prices, delivery, payment and validity.

items.name: Deviations and exceptions list
items.content: Technical and commercial exceptions to the RFQ with justification.

items.name: Clarification responses
items.content: Answers to TBE and commercial queries, revised offers.

items.name: Vendor document schedule
items.content: Vendor document numbers, project numbers, titles, types and planned submission dates.

items.name: Vendor GA drawings for review
items.content: Dimensions, nozzle sizes and orientations, weights, lifting points, access, terminal points.

items.name: Vendor foundation and load data
items.content: Anchor bolt layout, static and dynamic loads, operating and test weights.

items.name: Vendor design calculations
items.content: Thicknesses, MAWP, nozzle reinforcement, wind/seismic, allowable nozzle loads.

items.name: Package P&IDs
items.content: Package process and instrument scheme with vendor tags and battery-limit points.

items.name: Package I/O list and control narrative
items.content: Signals to and from DCS/SIS, communication protocol, control and shutdown description.

items.name: Package electrical data
items.content: Motor ratings, starting data, electrical loads, panel requirements, heat tracing.

items.name: Package instrument list and datasheets
items.content: Vendor-supplied instrument tags, types, ranges and datasheets.

items.name: Certified vendor drawings and data
items.content: Final certified GA, foundation, P&ID, electrical and instrument data.

items.name: Inspection and test plan
items.content: Inspection activities, acceptance criteria, hold and witness points.

items.name: Manufacturing schedule
items.content: Baseline milestones: drawings, material order, fabrication, tests, ex-works date.

items.name: Material test reports
items.content: MTRs per component with heat numbers, chemistry and mechanical properties.

items.name: Test certificates
items.content: Hydrotest, NDE, PMI, performance and FAT certificates.

items.name: Inspection notification
items.content: Test or inspection due, date and location, notice period.

items.name: Spool fabrication status
items.content: Spool number, isometric, status (cut, welded, NDE, painted, shipped), heat numbers per spool.

items.name: Steel shop drawings and fabrication status
items.content: Shop drawings, piece marks, erection drawings and fabrication/shipping status.

items.name: Packing list and shipping documents
items.content: Shipping pieces, item marks, tags, weights, dimensions, heat numbers, certificates of origin.

items.name: Nameplate and as-built data
items.content: Serial number, nameplate rating, MAWP, test pressure, as-built weights and dimensions.

items.name: MDR / data book
items.content: Certified drawings, calculations, MTRs, weld maps, NDE and test records, certificates.

items.name: IOM manuals
items.content: Installation, operation and maintenance instructions.

items.name: Spare parts interchangeability records
items.content: Part numbers, recommended quantities, prices and lead times per tag.

items.name: Site service reports
items.content: Installation checks, alignment, commissioning findings and sign-offs.

items.name: DCS/SIS configuration and FAT records
items.content: Configured database, logic, graphics, FAT punch list and FAT certificate.

items.name: Preservation and storage instructions
items.content: Storage conditions and preservation activities and frequencies per item.

items.name: Weld maps and NDE records
items.content: Weld map, WPS/PQR references, welder IDs and NDE results.

items.name: Manufacturing progress report
items.content: Milestone actuals, sub-order status, percent complete, forecast ex-works date and delays.
